اختلفوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَفُوا (iḵtalafū) /ix.ta.la.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَلَفَ (iḵtalafa)
# اِخْتَلِفُوا (iḵtalifū) /ix.ta.li.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَلَفَ (iḵtalafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
